note: Terms module-09 introduces, and the build that teaches each. Enforced by scripts/lint-glossary.mjs. Keep ASCII-only.

terms.gloss: One channel's version of the message - email, social or web - built from the single content record, never written from scratch.
The one record every rendition is built from. Change the price there and every channel changes; change it anywhere else and channels drift.
The tag on every link that says which campaign and channel a click came from. Built from a policy so Friday can join on it.
Copywriter, Brand Reviewer, Marketing Director, in order. Any edit starts it over: approvals belong to a version.
One approved message becoming a send per channel, each with its own text, code and time.
The weekly report that joins every channel's clicks to its campaign by tracking code - and names the events it could not place.
